_doc: npm advisories the security scan lets through: only ones with NO fixed version yet, only in development tools (never in what the app ships: `npm audit --omit=dev` must stay clean), each with a reason and an expiry. Past `until` the scan fails again so it gets looked at. scripts/npm-audit-filter.mjs reads this.

allow.reason: ReDoS on crafted extglob patterns; every picomatch version, no fix released. Only via vite/vitest/eslint (dev tools, our own glob patterns); the shipped app has no picomatch.
